title: NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover Collects Samples
originalTitle: NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover Collects Samples
content:
HQ Web Team

Nov 20, 2026

This Nov. 16 collage shows 49 drill holes captured by NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover as of November 2026. Each hole represents a sample collected from rocks on the Martian surface; Curiosity’s drill, located on the end of its robotic arm, drops pulverized rock samples into instruments in its belly that analyze their composition.
